title: HoloMap: Integrations
summary: Turn scans, records, weather, missions, and terminal links into useful map layers.

blocks.title: Connected Systems
blocks.body: WorldCore feeds region context, Convoy benefits from route clarity, Recovery marks return paths, and Lens or Wiki can explain what a marker represents.

blocks.title: Practical Pairings
blocks.body: Use HoloMap with WorldCore regions, PowerGrid infrastructure, Convoy routes, Recovery markers, and Terminal records for a shared operations picture.

blocks.title: Fallback Play
blocks.body: If a linked data source is absent, keep marker names plain and player-readable: hazard, loot, base, route, grave, power, or objective.

blocks.title: Fallback Check
blocks.body: If the helper addon is absent, keep the same order by hand and follow the manual checkpoint.
